arxiv-2006-01958.description: Abstract Finding dense components in graphs is of great importance in analysing the structure of networks. pmc-11416629.title: Interlinked Pathways: Exploring the Bidirectional Impacts of Periodontitis and Metabolic Syndrome
pmc-11416629.creator: Bandar M Barnawi, Maram M Alanazi, Fai A Al-Mutiri, Rahaf S Alqahtani, Madhawi S Al-harbi, Saud K Al-Raqqas, Waleed K Mahjoub, Mahdi M Alsetri, Ziyad M Al-Sultan, Ghadeer M Alghamdi, Ridha I Almutawah
pmc-11416629.description: Metabolic syndrome (MBS) and periodontitis are distinct conditions with overlapping and unique risk factors. Periodontitis is a chronic destructive disease of the periodontium, driven by alterations in the host immune-inflammatory response to virulent periodontal pathogens. MBS is characterized by various abnormalities, including visceral abdominal obesity, dyslipidemia (low high-density lipoprotein (HDL) and high triglyceride (TG) levels), hypertension, and hyperglycemia.

pmc-13195683.title: Youth development under digital surveillance: challenges, opportunities, and future directions
pmc-13195683.creator: Artur Ishkhanyan, Mane Hakobyan
pmc-13195683.description: Digital technologies now operate as developmental infrastructures, shaping how young people learn, relate, and form identities. We argue that contemporary surveillance systems do not simply observe youth but reorganize the relational and cultural conditions of development.
